The perfect banquet to end your Hanoi trip
Oct 2025 • Couples
Super liked this Michelin Green Star restaurant
1. Environment: Located in a small garden, the door entrance is an elegant restaurant, the open kitchen can see the chef's preparation
2. Service: service staff caring for the needs, each dish is carefully introduced, also find online pictures to give us reference to the ingredients, will also try their best to chat with us, be prepared
3. Restaurant concept: favorite part! The restaurant uses its own vegetable and fruit dishes, the main meat of the pork also comes from its own pigs, insist on using Vietnamese ingredients to present Vietnamese specialty cuisine, and insist on 0 waste, very careful
Meal: total of 7 dishes + 1 main meal + 3 desserts. There are a lot of new tastes, warmth and characteristics, and there are new ways to present Pho, the main meal of pork is delicate, dessert is also liked
5. non-alcohol pairing: 4 cups of Vietnamese apple juice, peppermint tea, red peppermint juice, a good drink of unproven herb juice, combined with fresh and good drink
The chef finally chatted with us, and he would speak Chinese, and share a little story with kindness.

AMAZING experience in Hanoi- Dont miss it
Feb 2024 • Couples
This is an amazing experience in a special place that looks more like a living room than a commercial restaurant. 10 minutes taxi ride from the old city, this is a residential area and the restaurant is hided behing a wall that conceals a beautiful garden and villa. We sat at the bar which allows for full view of what happens in the open kitchen. The tasting menu is balanced, very special and based on local produce and Vietnamese ingredients. Everything was so beautifully presented and the taste was always subtle and yet exciting. The price is also friendly for what you get so it is a highly recommended experience when in Hanoi. DONT MISS IT !

Lamai Garden is a delicious oasis in frenetic Hanoi!
Jan 2023 • Solo
I remember quite clearly my solo dinner at Lamai Garden on the third day of 2023. Snuggled in a quiet lane off West Lake and emanating a sea of calm even as the city celebrated the new year a few days before with fireworks and frenzy down at the old quarter, the restaurant should be on the radar of every Michelin inspector and Asia’s 50 Best judge. Understated, elegant and graceful, the meal was very pleasing especially Jardin de Lamai - the uplifting salad featuring incisive flavours of fresh greens and sautéed onions, and a most heartwarming chicken ginger leaf soup. Perhaps a downside could be the absence of red meat which could have paired with the claypot rice cooked in hay, a specialty of Hue. This was saved by the outstanding grilled grouper with robust green chilli, but was hoping for a crustacean to complete the excellent meal! Highly recommended.

Michelin quality dining experience
Apr 2023 • Couples
While Hanoi is quite rightly known for its street food scene we were keen to discover what it had to offer at a fine dining level and Lamai Garden showed that it has the potential to deliver the highest quality quality food. The Spring set menu gave us seven courses that, for all of their delicacy, had the complexity and depth of flavour you’d expect from Vietnamese food. The accompanying wine pairing complimented the food perfectly. If Lamai Garden carry on doing what they are doing it’s only a matter of time before Hanoi can boast a Michelin star restaurant.
